digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — drift scope and attestation
propositions: A container ticket with no declared file_impact falls back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing the attestation to be invalidated by any unrelated commit and forcing unnecessary re-reviews.

Container plan-review should compute its dependency set as the union of its own file_impact, review citations, and the direct children's file_impact, applying a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the set reverts to pre-change behavior (own ∪ citations).

The poison rule ensures fail-closed invalidation: undeclared child scopes do not silently inherit, and child file_impact edits already invalidate the container via material-fingerprint pins (existing lattice), preventing stale inherited unions one level deep.

P9 determinism floor should issue an advisory (never blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the non-closed children lacking file_impact, while passing containers with effective inheritance and leaving leaf behavior unchanged.

Child state (including file_impact and status) must be threaded from the orchestrator's assembled context (ctx.children) through sign_plan_review into dependency_hashes, avoiding new store reads and tickets-root ambiguity in attested mode.
